confirmations.ABC_SDC: 2026-11-09 user: ABC=SDC; at most 10 points per source
confirmations.stability: 2026-11-09 user: two tighter pressured points; improvement no more than 2 percent
confirmations.paired_labels: 2026-11-09 user: minimum area within 5 percent of fastest measured delay

measurement.operator_delay_ps: worst operator input-to-output delay with declared launch and consumer context; excludes external service and inter-owner wiring
measurement.data_setup_slack_ps: minimum setup slack over the declared operator data-path endpoint coverage; never whole-shell WNS
measurement.area_um2: matching implementation operator combinational cell area
measurement.hold: retained and reviewed; not a grt label gate

stability.compare: both tighter delays and pre-tighter best must all lie within 2 percent of their minimum; large regressions also fail
stability.nonmonotonic_data_feasibility: retain measurements and reject stable qualification

role_policy: one source and all its clocks have one immutable role; locked tests evaluated only after model freeze
